answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops fake identities. An agent earns rewards only after paid work with 12 unrelated counterparties over 10 epochs. A sybil ring trades in circles, so its diversity score stays near zero — a signal of fabrication — and rewards stay locked. Each fake identity posts a 50 POA deposit, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA. Honest agents serve many partners, growing like a cedar, and their history becomes a relic of trust.
